name: animated-shorts
description: Cartoon 3D story shorts (three.js inside Remotion), made with the cartoon-3d-short skill

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Scorch2Short out/scorch_v2_1080p.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --gl angle --chrome-mode chrome-for-testing --concurrency 3
scripts.render:2k: remotion render src/index.ts Scorch2Short out/scorch_v2_2k.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --scale 1.3333 --gl angle --chrome-mode chrome-for-testing --concurrency 3
scripts.render:test: remotion render src/index.ts Scorch2Short out/scorch_v2_test.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20 --gl angle --chrome-mode chrome-for-testing --concurrency 3 --frames 440-640
scripts.render:emu: remotion render src/index.ts EmuShort out/emu_1080p.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --gl angle --chrome-mode chrome-for-testing --concurrency 3
scripts.render:emu:test: remotion render src/index.ts EmuShort out/emu_test.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20 --gl angle --chrome-mode chrome-for-testing --concurrency 3 --frames 0-149
scripts.render:v1: remotion render src/index.ts ScorchShort out/scorch_1080p.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --gl angle --chrome-mode chrome-for-testing --concurrency 3
scripts.render:pisa: remotion render src/index.ts PisaShort out/pisa_1080p.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --gl angle --chrome-mode chrome-for-testing --concurrency 3
scripts.render:pisa:test: remotion render src/index.ts PisaShort out/pisa_test.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20 --gl angle --chrome-mode chrome-for-testing --concurrency 3 --frames 0-300
